A '''battle''' took place on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] that was a contained conflict in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] between the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] of [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] and a [[Gorax/Legends|Gorax]], in an attempt to reunite two human children, [[Mace Towani|Mace]] and [[Cindel Towani]], with their parents, [[Jeremitt Towani|Jeremitt]] and [[Catarine Towani]], who had been imprisoned by the Gorax. The battle was a victory for the Ewoks, ending in the death of the Gorax and the reunification of the [[Towani family|Towani]] family. 

==Prelude==
The Towani family, while traveling in their [[Towani family star cruiser|star cruiser]], crashed on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. While stranded on the moon, the family became separated into two groups; one between the parents Jeremitt and Catarine Towani, and one between their children Mace and Cindel Towani. Seperated from their children, the parents became captured by a local Gorax and taken back to its lair in the [[Forbidden Fortress of the Gorax]].<ref name="coc" />

Mace and Cindel, who briefly became separated from their crashed star cruiser, returned. There, they were discovered by [[Deej Warrick]] and two of his children, [[Weechee Warrick|Weechee]] and [[Widdle Warrick/Legends|Widdle Warrick]]. The Ewoks took the remaining Towani to Bright Tree Village, where a sick Cindel was cared for. The relationship between the Ewoks and Mace was rocky initially, but Mace grew to trust the Ewoks over the course of their stay, especially so after the Ewoks saved the lives of both Mace and Cindel from a [[Boar-wolf/Legends|boar-wolf]]. After the battle with the beast, they discovered the [[Life monitor/Legends|life monitor]] of one of the Towani parents strapped to its back. Realizing that their parents may not be dead, Mace asked another of Deej's children, [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket]], where the boar-wolf originated. Wicket then revealed to Mace that the boar-wolf was likely owned by the local Gorax.<ref name="coc" />

Returning to Bright Tree Village, Mace asked [[Logray/Legends|Logray]], the village mystic, to reveal the location of his parents. Using his [[crystal image spinner]], Logray revealed the location of the Towani parents, showing that they were both still alive and held by the Gorax. Cindel begged Deej and Logray to help her and Mace save their parents, and reluctantly they agreed. <ref name="coc" />

Logray assembled the Ewok caravan to lead a charge against the Gorax, which included Deej, Weechee, Widdle, Wicket, Mace, and Cindel. Logray also gave all of them the sacred totems of the legendary Ewok warriors to help them on their journey, including two extra totems given in hopes of recruiting more Ewoks on their journey. On the journey, the group recruited the Ewok lumberjack [[Chukha-Trok/Legends|Chukha-Trok]] and the Ewok [[Priestess]] [[Kaink/Legends|Kaink]]. The group also recruited the [[Wistie/Legends|Wistie]], [[Izrina]], who became seperated from the rest of her people. <ref name="coc" />

After a lengthy and treacherous journey across the forest moon, the group reached the [[Desert of Salma/Legends|Desert of Salma]] where they entered the Forbidden Fortress of the Gorax. As the caravan entered, Deej asked that the youngest members of the group, Wicket, Widdle, and Cindel stay behind, which they do, exchanging hugs as the rest of the caravan pushed further into the Gorax's lair. Both groups were then attacked by a [[Rearing spider]], which they both managed to fight off. <ref name="coc" />

==The battle==
The group then found themselves at the bottom of a giant staircase, where they were attacked by a third spider, which Wicket then killed with a knife. Then, they climbed the steps to the top, where they found the Gorax's lair. Mace then heard the Gorax and told the others to run and hide with him. However, Weechee didn't make it out in time, and had to hide behind the Gorax's giant ax as the Gorax sat down at his table eating off of a bone. It then got up to look at its next meal: Jeremitt and Catarine, who were hanging in a cage from the ceiling.<ref name="coc" />

Weechee then accidentally knocked the ax over, which garnered the Gorax's attention, causing it to come after him. He ran to the rest of the group, who again ran and hide. Mace then wondered how they will reach their parents, and Chukha-Trok suggested they use the Gorax's ax as a lever. Mace stood on one end, at which point Jeremitt and Catarine noticed him. Chukha-Trok and Deej jumped off a ledge onto the other end of the lever, which sent Mace flying up into the air, where he grabbed hold of the cage containing his parents. Mace then threw down a rope, and introduced Chukha-Trok as "a friend" as he climbed up.<ref name="coc" />

Mace climbed down first, but as soon as he reached the bottom, the Gorax noticed their activity. Weechee then distracted it by hiding under a basket and moving across the floor. The Gorax smashed the basket, but found nothing underneath. Weechee ran out from behind a corner, which enraged the Gorax. Meanwhile, everyone continued climbing down from the cage, which was beginning to break. Weechee ran back to warn them, with the Gorax on his trail. The cage broke, and Chukha-Trok fell into the hands of Jeremitt. They ran out of the Gorax's lair, but Chukha-Trok stayed behind and repeatedly attacked the Gorax's foot with his ax.<ref name="coc" />

As Mace was yelling for him to come on, Izrina lit up in his pocket. Mace unleashed Izrina on the Gorax, which disoriented it while Chukha-Trok continued his attacks. In a rage, the Gorax struck the walls of his fortress, which caused rocks to crumble and fall on Chukha-Trok. Mace ran to him, but realized that Chukha-Trok was dying. Before he died, Chukha-Trok gave Mace his ax.<ref name="coc" />

The Gorax chased the survivors down the giant steps, but they used a pulled-tight rope to trip him. Kaink then used her magic wand to cause a stalactite to fall on his head. Catarine then used Mace's blaster to shoot the Gorax in the chest, which caused him to fall off the ledge into the pit. Mace then showed Deej Chukha-Trok's ax, and explained his sacrifice to them.<ref name="coc" />

Cindel, Wicket and Widdle then appeared on the other side of the chasm. But at that moment, the Gorax emerged from the pit and moved toward them. Mace threw Chukha-Trok's ax into the Gorax's back, which caused him to fall back into the pit. The group then swung across the chasm using a remaining part of the spider web as rope. Once they were safely on the other side, the family embraced, happy to be back together and out of danger. They then headed for home, with Mace suggesting that Izrina will help guide the way.<ref name="coc" />

==Aftermath==
The Towani family, finally reunited, celebrated with the Bright Tree Village after their victory.<ref name="coc" /> The family temporarily moved in with the Ewoks as Jeremitt resumed his work on the Towani family star cruiser, once again attempting to leave the moon after being stopped by the Gorax. Unforunatly for them, Bright Tree Village was [[Raid on Bright Tree Village|attacked]] by a group of [[Sanyassan Marauders/Legends|Sanyassan Marauders]] soon after the battle with the Gorax, and the Towani family, save for Cindel, were killed in the raid. <ref name=":0">''[[Ewoks: The Battle for Endor]]''</ref>

After another long and perilous [[Ewoks: The Battle for Endor|journey of her own]], Cindel would work together again with Wicket, as well as the hermit [[Noa Briqualon]] and his partner [[Teek (Teek)|Teek]] to finally escape the moon. <ref name=":0" />
